RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of sex discrimination. For senior roles like department head, selection committees often prioritize demonstrated management credentials and broad leadership experience over higher technical degrees such as a PhD. The successful candidate had dedicated management training and extensive leadership experience, which are legitimate, non-discriminatory selection factors.

Accusing the panel of gender bias without concrete proof—such as biased remarks or procedural violations—will harm your professional reputation and hospital relationships. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your debrief. Frame it constructively around career development, asking specifically how the panel weighted formal management qualifications and leadership scale against technical laboratory expertise.
